profile.name: Youhan Huang
profile.affiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
profile.bio: I am an undergraduate at BUPT working on computer vision and intelligent sensing. I care about clean problem formulations, reproducible experiments, and systems that connect perception algorithms to real sensing hardware.

education.school: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
details: Selected coursework: Engineering Mathematics (97), Linear Algebra (94), Computer Networks (97), Programming Fundamentals (96), Introduction to AI (95), Machine Learning (95)

news.text: Co-first author (ranked first) paper accepted as Oral at ICME 2026 (CCF-B).
Joined the Image Aesthetics Assessment group at BUPT; supporting ST-VAA / long-form video aesthetics research.
Led construction and open-sourcing of a multi-task mouse NAFLD pathology scoring dataset.
Joined the Pattern Recognition & Intelligent Vision Lab at BUPT for PolTrans (polarization-guided transparent object reconstruction).
Started research internship at Peking University on multi-radar sensing (TriCal) and low-bandwidth mmWave pose estimation (mmGlimpse).

research.role: Project Lead · Mouse NAFLD Multi-Task Pathology Scoring
research.summary: Built a curated multi-task NAFLD histology dataset and a subspace-decoupled multi-task ViT with task-specific Adapters and orthogonality constraints to reduce negative transfer among NAS indicators. Co-first author (ranked first); ICME 2026 Oral.

Contributed to TriCal, a device-free multi-radar calibration system that models walking humans as elliptical cylinders (IEEE TMC, under review). Also supported mmGlimpse for real-time human pose estimation on low-cost 24 GHz radars under tight bandwidth (ACM SenSys, under review).

research.org: BUPT · Pattern Recognition & Intelligent Vision Lab
research.summary: Worked on PolTrans: polarization-guided neural implicit surface reconstruction for transparent objects, combining a neural Stokes environment field with dual-surface Mueller transport. First-author paper under review at AAAI 2027.
Supported ST-VAA research that reframes video aesthetics from holistic scoring to spatiotemporal quantification, including baselines, evaluations, and writing. Paper under review at IEEE TIP.
